About these 2 rides

They ride on Thursdays and Saturdays; Thursday has the most, with 2. The earliest start is DC Queer Bike Rides at 12:00 pm; the latest is OutRiders DC Thursday Night Ride at 6:15 pm. The group waits for everyone on 1 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 1. By bike: 2 social and 1 road. They run 1 every week and 1 every other week. Both were checked at the source on Oct 1, 2026.
